en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the dining hall.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we talk about?

I agree!
Moving around after a meal is necessary!

Oh, but exercising right after you eat
can cause indigestion!
My advice—exercise two hours after a meal!
I know how degenerate males think.

You're trying to impress girls by showing off
your coffee-drinking skills, aren't you!?

Males are so shallow.
Girls would never fall for that.
How would you like to die, Shuichi?

You must know already, since you've
chosen to aggravate me.

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Tenko looks deep in thought...
